definitions: Convey, channel, or direct (something, especially water or gas) through a pipe or pipes.
Play (music) on a pipe or bagpipes.
Decorate (a cake or other food) with a design of icing or cream forced through a pipe or a piping bag.
Look at or follow with one's eyes.
Send (a signal or data) through a channel or connection.
examples: Water is piped to the houses.
She piped the edges of the cake with buttercream.
He piped her as she walked away.
The output of the first command is piped to the input of the second.
